newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bajaj up 10 pct on bonus news.
newsitem.headline: India Bajaj up 10 pct on bonus news.

text.p: Shares of Indian two-wheeler maker Bajaj Auto Ltd rose 10 percent on the Bombay bourse on Wednesday after the firm said it would meet on Monday to consider a bonus equity issue, traders said.
The share rose 83.25 rupees, or 9.79 percent, to 933 rupees shortly after the firm scheduled a meeting of its board on May 19.
The board also recommended a dividend of 10 rupees per share of 10-rupee face value for the year ended March 31, 1997.
India's largest scooter-maker said it had made net profits of 4.4 billion rupees for the financial year ending March 31, 1997, as compared to 4.18 billion the previous year.
